floorPlans.draftEditorDescription: Resume the persisted complete snapshot and adjust resource placements. Unsaved changes are protected during navigation.
floorPlans.draftSaveError: The floor-plan draft could not be saved. Refresh the resource versions and retry.
floorPlans.backgroundCurrent: A verified background image is attached to this draft.
floorPlans.backgroundEmpty: No background image is attached to this draft.
floorPlans.backgroundUploaded: The verified background image was attached to the floor-plan draft.
floorPlans.backgroundUploadError: The background image could not be uploaded. Check the draft version and file.
floorPlans.backgroundInvalidType: Only PNG or JPEG images are supported.
floorPlans.backgroundTooLarge: The background image must be 10 MB or smaller.
floorPlans.saveLayoutBeforeBackground: Save placement changes before uploading a background image.
floorPlans.zoneRequired: Create an active zone on this floor before adding unplaced resources.
floorPlans.createDescription: Clone the current projection or selected history into a complete new snapshot.
floorPlans.publishedDescription: The atomic floor plan projected into member exploration
floorPlans.emptyRevisionsDescription: Create the first draft to begin the review and release workflow.
floorPlans.emptyPublishedDescription: Publish a reviewed draft to atomically project it to member experiences.

transitionNotice.REVIEW: The draft cannot be edited after it enters review.
transitionNotice.PUBLISH: The current publication will be archived and this revision immediately projected to member experiences.
transitionNotice.RESTORE: The selected history will be cloned into a new editable draft.

transitionSuccess.REVIEW: The floor plan moved into review.
transitionSuccess.RESTORE: A new draft was created from the selected history.

delegation.leastPrivilege: Delegated administrators act only within an explicit building or verified group scope and lose access automatically at expiry.
delegation.assignmentsDescription: Least-privilege permissions and validity periods for members and groups
delegation.effectiveDescription: Scopes applied to the current session user and verified groups
delegation.emptyDescription: Only central administrators currently operate all Workplace locations.
delegation.noEffectiveDescription: This session is using central authority or a separate authorization policy.
delegation.expiryNotice: Delegations without expiry require periodic access review. An end time aligned to the assignment is recommended.
delegation.floorOptionsUnavailable: Current floor information is unavailable. Recheck the site and floor information.
delegation.immutableRange: To change the saved floor scope, revoke the existing delegation and create a new one.
delegation.reviewImpactScope: Changes apply only to the selected delegation's site scope, actions, and validity period.
delegation.reviewApplicationAccess: Administrative delegation does not grant access to the Workplace or meeting-room application.
delegation.reviewPropagation: Changes are checked on subsequent management actions. External approval is not requested, and other open screens may take time to refresh.

policy.title: Workplace operating policy
policy.description: Apply advance windows, working hours, check-in, and colleague visibility as company policy.
policy.loadError: The Workplace policy could not be loaded.
policy.saveError: The Workplace policy could not be saved.
policy.unsavedDescription: The Workplace policy has changes that have not been saved. Leaving now will discard them.
policy.validationError: Closing time must be later than opening time, and duration and consecutive-day limits must be valid.
policy.bookingWindowHint: Set how far ahead members can reserve desks and shared spaces.
policy.allowAssignedDeskLending: Allow assigned desks to be shared while idle
policy.allowAssignedDeskLendingHint: When disabled, an assigned desk cannot be reserved by anyone except its assignee.
policy.showNames: Show member names on reserved spaces
policy.bookingRetentionDaysHint: Names, member identifiers, and purposes on completed, cancelled, and no-show bookings are anonymized after this period. Legal holds are excluded.
